name: Emoji Stealer
description: Right-click or long-press a custom emoji to copy it into your personal pack or a room/space pack you can edit.
author: az4521

settings.label: Right-click to steal
settings.description: Right-clicking a custom emoji opens the steal popover instead of the browser menu.

settings.label: Long-press to steal
settings.description: Long-pressing a custom emoji on touch screens opens the steal popover (replaces the message menu for that press).

settings.label: Include reactions
settings.description: Also steal from custom emoji reactions. Long-pressing a custom reaction then no longer shows who reacted.

settings.label: "Steal emoji" message action
settings.description: Add a Steal emoji entry to the menu of messages that contain custom emoji.
